errors.text_span: wobei positive Werte eine Zunahme der Zufriedenheit anzeigen
errors.evidence: The prompt asks to avoid drawing conclusions or making inferences. Stating that positive values indicate an increase in satisfaction is an inference based on the y-axis label 'Differenz der Mittelwerte 2024 zu 2022', which goes beyond a purely objective description of the visual elements.

errors.text_span: wobei unter „Leben“ und „Einkommen“ die Ergänzung „Zufriedenheit mit dem/der ...“ steht
errors.evidence: The label 'Zufriedenheit mit dem/der ...' is a general label for the horizontal axis and is visually centered under the categories 'Einkommen' and 'Familienleben'. The description incorrectly states that it is located under 'Leben' and 'Einkommen', which misrepresents the labeling structure of the chart.
